text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Air Shakur got injured during training, so I hurried over to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
What a pain in the ass...
Guess regular training is out of the question today.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"I'm prepared to adjust the program,
but I need to keep the scope as minimal as possible..."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hey, we're continuing training.
Doing nothing doesn't just leave you at zero—it sets you back into the negative.
choice_data_list: Let's definitely take today off to rest.
Let's look for something we can do together.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Haaah? Can you seriously not even
understand a normal conversation?
choice_data_list: If the worst happens, losing points will be the least of our worries.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorting the data. You ain't gonna stop me
from typing on the keyboard too, are ya?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I'll make a list of what's needed and send it to ya,
so bring it over.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur grumbled irritably
and began aggressively clacking away at her keyboard.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I'm just doin' some light exercise so my muscles don't waste away.
I don't need your damn support.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, Air Shakur began her training at the gym, but...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...*sigh*... Change of plans.
My body's screamin' at me to rest.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seemed the pain flared up again, as Air Shakur
cut training short and headed back.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Phew... If I can move this well, there's no problem.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I'll keep going at this pace for a while.
Don't need any unnecessary interference from you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur trained within a reasonable limit,
taking care not to risk any injury.
